title: Render pass colour dependency with srcAccessMask 0: the shared multisampled target's clear races the previous frame's writes
fix_note: no fix merged (issue open); the fixed variant applies the fix identified in the issue: dependencies[1].srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT
expected_finding: multisampleTarget.color is cleared by every frame's vkCmdBeginRenderPass, but the EXTERNAL -> 0 colour dependency has srcAccessMask 0, so the previous frame's colour attachment writes / storeOp are not made available before the clear (write-after-write)
